comments.author: @cristianeoliveira-basora8382
comments.text: I love the Azores. I have been to 3 islands (São Miguel, Terceira & Faial) and going to visit 2 additional ones in 6 months (Flores & Corvo). All are beautiful and unique. I can’t describe how amazing and beautiful they are. Even though people are discovering this amazing destination, for being a UNESCO site most of the main places in the islands, I pray that visitors & developers keep untouched their natural beauty.
